title: eval-harness: per-prompt CI hooks + metrics integration for prompt-set quality gating
author: Riley Carter
description: Motivation: we need finer-grained CI gating for per-prompt regressions and tighter integration of eval metrics into PR checks so model/serving changes are validated against prompt sets and quality thresholds before merge. This PR introduces a per-prompt CI hook, a metrics reporter that folds eval-harness outputs into GitHub checks, and a configurable quality-gates YAML to drive pass/fail logic. Changes: 1) add .github workflow `prompt-ci.yml` that runs eval-harness per-prompt jobs in parallel and posts a summarized check with pass/fail per-prompt; 2) add `hooks/per_prompt_hook.py` which runs the prompt set, computes metrics (accuracy/score/delta vs baseline), and emits a machine-readable report; 3) add `metrics/ci_reporter.py` which uploads the summary to the GitHub Checks API and attaches artifacts for triage; 4) add `config/default_gates.yaml` with recommended thresholds (per-prompt and aggregate) and documentation in `docs/quality-gates.md`; 5) tests and integration harness to simulate regression scenarios. Backwards compatibility: workflow is optional and guarded by `paths`/labels; defaults keep CI cost bounded. Checklist: - [x] add per-prompt hook and reporter - [x] wire up workflow with parallel jobs - [x] add config + docs - [x] unit + integration tests - [x] basic docs/usage example - [x] reviewed and approved by two reviewers - [x] CI passes (lint/test) Performance notes: the per-prompt jobs are parallelized and have a configurable timeout to avoid stalls; the reporter batches artifacts to reduce API calls. Rollout: merge to main will not enable the workflow for all repos until the org-level `prompt-ci` workflow is flipped on; this PR adds the capability and a migration note in docs. Related: ENG-4621 for automation roadmap, PM-118 for quality gate spec.
